description: Searches one country's official company register by name and returns registered companies in one consistent shape: number, legal name, status, legal form, dates, town and postcode, and a link to the register entry. Covers GB, NO, FR, FI, CZ, SK, IE, AU, the worldwide LEI register, and US entities in any state that hold an LEI (with their state filing number). Companies only, no directors or contact details.

country.description: Register to search: gb, no, fr, fi, cz, sk, ie, au, us, or global for the LEI register.

limit.description: Most companies to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

state.description: With country us only: the US state the entity was formed in, two letters (de, ny, tx). Default: any state.

name: search_company_registry
title: Search an official company registry
